none: PAS CAM-098D73: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, AD 364-375.
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE ; D/ D N VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, AD 364-375 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Mint is Siscia, AD 367-375. See LRBC p.73, c.f.1376.ff. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: ?//.SIS. . Condition…
